entities.name: Church of the Nativity of Christ, Pirot
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Church of the Nativity of Christ, also known as The Old Church, is a Serbian Orthodox church building located in Pirot in the district of the same name in southeastern Serbia. It is listed as a Protected Monument of Culture.
